image_copy: byte-identical files in images/train, images/val, images/test
coco_file_name: split/original_filename; use data_prefix.img=images/ for all JSON files
split_policy: Preserve original image-level split and existing split_group_id; no new scene attribution or resplitting
anomaly_policy: Report and stop; never clip, repair or discard a box silently
existing_destination_policy: Stop if nonempty; never overwrite an existing dataset
